headline_marked: ChronicleOps: [[Autonomous Chaos Engineering]] & Self-Healing Telemetry Engine
headline: ChronicleOps: Autonomous Chaos Engineering & Self-Healing Telemetry Engine
summary: This new platform uses Gemini AI to automatically detect, diagnose, and recover from system failures, reducing downtime.
details: ChronicleOps is a new autonomous platform designed for cloud chaos engineering, real-time observability, and self-healing. It allows developers to simulate system failures and automatically recover services, while Gemini AI provides root-cause diagnoses.

The platform enables developers to spin up application stacks, inject controlled fault vectors like process kills or container crashes, and observe telemetry degradation. ChronicleOps then automatically recovers services and generates detailed root-cause reports.

Key features include a 1-Click Demo Quickstart for easy provisioning, controlled chaos injection, and real-time canvas telemetry with 1.0s RTC uptime signals. It also offers autonomous self-healing with automated restarts and MTTR calculation.

For diagnosis, ChronicleOps correlates logs against historical incident data using Gemini AI to generate confidence scores and recommended fixes. The system also automatically prunes expired demo environments to manage platform resources.

ChronicleOps is built natively on Zerops infrastructure, leveraging its deployment pipeline and multi-service orchestration capabilities. A live demo dashboard and the main GitHub repository are available for users to explore.

headline_marked: [[Google Gemini]] Plans Vacation, Uses Travel History to Personalize Itinerary
headline: Google Gemini Plans Vacation, Uses Travel History to Personalize Itinerary
summary: AI assistant leverages Google Maps data to suggest restaurants and activities, even filtering out previously visited spots for a tailored travel experience.
details: A user tasked Google Gemini with planning a vacation to Goa, India, aiming to discover new experiences beyond familiar locations. The AI was prompted to consider a budget of Rs 1,00,000 for four days, with specific daily meal and drink cost limits, and a preference for areas like Anjuna, Vagator, Assagao, and Siolim.

Gemini initially provided recommendations by analyzing recent restaurant reviews, traffic data, peak hours, and current images, integrating information from Google Maps. It also factored in food preferences and drink costs within the specified budget, and planned daily itineraries with visual route suggestions and optimal times for attractions.

When the initial suggestions were too generic or included places the user had already visited, Gemini was prompted again. The AI then utilized the user's travel history from Google Maps to filter out previously visited locations, demonstrating a personalized approach to itinerary planning.

Further refinement of the prompts led Gemini to suggest fine dining options across various cuisines (Goan, Italian, Indian, Asian) and breakfast spots, all with a minimum rating of 4.2. The AI also incorporated requests for local activities and less crowded beach experiences.

The user found Gemini's ability to learn from past interactions and integrate personal travel history to be a significant time-saver, transforming the AI into a highly effective local tour guide for a more customized and efficient vacation planning process.
